subject: Building-Wide Inspection Notice - {{building_name}}
body:
Dear {{student_name}},

This is to inform you that a building-wide inspection will be conducted for {{building_name}}.

**Inspection Details:**
- Building: {{building_name}}
- Your Room: {{room_number}}
- Date: {{inspection_date}}
- Type: {{inspection_type}}
- Inspector: {{inspector_name}}

**Scope:**
This inspection will cover all rooms in {{building_name}} including common areas, hallways, and individual rooms.

**What You Need to Do:**
- Ensure your room is accessible on the inspection date
- Make sure your room is in good condition
- Remove any items blocking access to fixtures, outlets, or safety equipment
- Secure or remove any valuables you prefer not to be disturbed

**Timeline:**
The inspection team will be working through all rooms in the building. We appreciate your patience and cooperation.

{{additional_notes}}

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
Housing Management Team
University Housing Services
